name: OSLO Besluit
use: Meeting, agenda item, treatment, vote, decision and condition patterns; no import of Flemish legal applicability.

name: Popolo
use: People, organizations, posts, memberships, motions, vote events, votes and counts.

name: Legistar API
use: Operational interchange model for events, event items, matters and votes; not a vendor integration in this run.

name: Akoma Ntoso / LegalDocML
use: Legal-document structure, metadata, references and versions; complete XML exporter not tested.

name: W3C ORG
use: Organization/post/membership patterns; vendor or lessee is not automatically an organizational member.

name: PROV-O
use: Entities, activities, agents and derivation for source and interpretation lineage.

name: Web Annotation
use: Text quote and position selectors pinned to an exact text representation.

name: RDF Data Cube
use: Financial research observations with explicit dimensions; not a GASB accounting taxonomy.

name: Open Contracting Data Standard
use: Distinct planning, tender, award, contract and implementation stages.

name: SHACL
use: Proposed structural validation; shapes were parsed, but no SHACL engine was run.

name: OWL-Time
use: Reference for temporal modeling; observed, effective, publication and verification times remain separate.

name: NYS Public Officers Law §106
use: Authority reference for minutes and matters voted on; not a complete OML applicability test.

name: NYS Civil Service Law §204-a
use: Authority reference for agreements requiring legislative action; executed agreement still needed.

name: MSRB Rule G-42
use: Role/client-specific municipal-advisor duties; not all financial participants have identical duties.
